name: Solomon
bio:
Solomon was a son born to David in Jerusalem, first named simply among his many brothers (2 Samuel 5:14) — the child who would grow up to inherit David's throne, build the temple the LORD promised through Nathan, and become Israel's most celebrated king for his wisdom and wealth.

Solomon's birth is told in full after David's affair with Bathsheba and the death of their first child, born while Uriah was still her husband. After that infant's death, David comforted Bathsheba, and she conceived again; the son she bore was named Solomon, and the LORD loved him, sending word through the prophet Nathan that he should also be called Jedidiah, meaning "beloved of the LORD" (2 Samuel 12:24-25) — a quiet sign of grace at the start of a story shadowed by his parents' sin. His rise to the throne, his reign, and his legacy unfold in detail across the rest of Samuel, 1 Kings, and 1-2 Chronicles.
